keypoints.name: Network Extraction
keypoints.description: Network extraction involves generating S-parameters or models for a network to later embed or de-embed from a VNA test port. It's useful for extracting circuit portions, test fixture launches, or in situations where CAL kits are unavailable.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced early, covered in a dedicated section, and mentioned throughout the first half of the transcript; central to the video.
representative_quotes: Network extraction is a tool that we use to generate the S-parameters or the model for some network
But there's also other uses for network extraction.

keypoints.name: Embedding and De-embedding
keypoints.description: Embedding and de-embedding are techniques for adding or removing networks from VNA measurements, such as matching networks or fixtures. It allows isolating the device under test and viewing results with or without the added/removed network.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced early, developed with examples, demonstrated live, and reiterated, showing high importance.

Or in the case of de-embedding we can remove a fixture
You would load an S4P file. You would add that to your network

keypoints.name: Differential Probes
keypoints.description: Differential probes are designed to measure differential signals by creating a virtual ground and rejecting common mode noise. True differential probes have coupled transmission lines, unlike dual probes which use isolated coax cables.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Covered in a dedicated section, mentioned multiple times by Brian, but not returned to at the end.
representative_quotes: I want to discuss what is a differential probe
In a true differential probe...is that it sends a positive and negative pulse down the transmission line

keypoints.name: Atai Tech ISD Software
keypoints.description: Atai Tech's ISD software is used for in situ de-embedding and creates S4P models for differential probes. It requires open, short, and in situ measurements to accurately model coupling and crosstalk.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced early, demoed, and used throughout the presentation and demo, reinforcing its purpose.
representative_quotes: we're going to use the Atai Tech ISD software to perform this network extraction
the in situ de embedding or ISD software that allows us to create a differential probe
We're going to use the TIA-TECH software next.

keypoints.name: VNA Four Port Differential Measurements
keypoints.description: A four-port VNA is essential for differential measurements because it enables differential signal measurements and de-embedding. Enritsu's VNA family offers features like superposition to convert single-ended S-parameters to differential S-parameters.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced early and frequently explained throughout the presentation, underlining its use in differential probing.
representative_quotes: we need a four port VNA to do that
So all of these measurements are possible with a four port VNA.
